tasks.instruction: Fix pollVoteRequest so a malformed poll with fewer than 2 or more than 4 options cannot produce a vote RPC request. Preserve normal 2–4 option behavior, anonymous/named mode, deadlines and question rejection. No UI/schema/SQL changes. The immutable acceptance test already fails on this real boundary defect.

Fix quizAuditReport([]) without an expected count so empty offline exports are REVIEW_REQUIRED, never STRUCTURE_PASS. Keep parseQuizQuestions([]) legal for empty runtime RPC results; keep nonempty valid audits and publication_approved=false. Do not alter questions, scoring, UI or DB.

Fix aggregate in gto/hand169.py: math.fsum of finite reach weights can raise OverflowError before the intended mass validation. Convert overflow into clear ValueError validation while preserving finite ordinary weighted frequencies/EV, original solver source, rules and checkpoints. Do not implement a new solver or change game semantics.

Extend auditPlayerType to fail on persona.answers lengths other than 50 and on answer letters not present in the matching question. Existing personas use A/B/C etc by ordered option position. Keep checked-in fixtures/scoring/thresholds/SQL untouched and keep normal report CONDITIONAL PASS with semantic UNKNOWN. Do not mutate input.
